gizmo.title: Huli hua ʻōlelo
gizmo.description: He mānoanoa hua palapala me nā hua ʻōlelo hūnā. Paʻi nā haumāna i ka hua palapala mua a me ka hope o kēlā me kēia hua ʻōlelo. Hoʻomaʻamaʻa i ka ʻike ʻana i ka pela ʻana o kekahi huaʻōlelo, ʻaʻole kona manaʻo.

configure.title: Poʻo inoa
configure.description: Ka mea i noi ʻia i nā haumāna e loaʻa, hōʻike ʻia ma ke poʻo.

configure.title: Nā hua ʻōlelo
configure.description: Nā hua ʻōlelo e hūnā ai. Waiho ʻia nā kikowā a me nā kaha kiko ma waho o ka mānoanoa. Papa inoa ʻia nā hua ʻōlelo komo ʻole ʻoiai ʻoe e hoʻoponopono ana a waiho ʻia no nā haumāna.

advanced.title: Nui mānoanoa
advanced.description: Nā hua palapala ma kēlā me kēia ʻaoʻao, 4 a i 16. E waiho hakahaka e kūpono i ka hua ʻōlelo lōʻihi loa (a hiki i 12). ʻOi aku ma mua o 12, kaʻa ʻaoʻao ma ke kelepona.

advanced.title: Nā hua ʻōlelo hiō
advanced.description: Hūnā pū i nā hua ʻōlelo hiō. ʻOi aku ka paʻakikī.

advanced.title: Nā hua ʻōlelo i hope
advanced.description: Hūnā pū i nā hua ʻōlelo i kākau ʻia i hope. ʻOi aku ka paʻakikī.

advanced.title: Waihoʻoluʻu koʻikoʻi
advanced.description: Waihoʻoluʻu koho no ka ʻāpana poʻo, ka hua palapala mua i koho ʻia a me ke pihi.
